```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue number to fix'
        required: true
        type: string
      instructions:
        description: 'Optional instructions for Claude'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    concurrency:
      group: claude-code-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: read
    steps:
      - name: Check collaborator permission
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const username = context.actor;
            const { data: membership } = await github.repos.getCollaboratorPermissionLevel({
              owner,
              repo,
              username
            });
            if (!['admin', 'write'].includes(membership.permission)) {
              core.setFailed(`User ${username} does not have write/admin permission`);
            }

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Claude Code
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            Fix issue #${{ inputs.issue_number }}${{ inputs.instructions && ', ' + inputs.instructions || '' }}.
          max_turns: 3
          timeout_minutes: 10
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Check for changes
        id: changes
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create draft PR
        if: steps.changes.outputs.no_changes != 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: claude-code-${{ inputs.issue_number }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          base: main
          title: "Claude Code fix for issue #${{ inputs.issue_number }}"
          commit-message: "Claude Code fix for issue #${{ inputs.issue_number }}"
          draft: true
          assignees: ${{ github.actor }}
          add-paths: |
            **/*
```
